items.title: Who's earning the 4% on all the USDC parked in prediction markets?
items.snippet: Not sure this ever came up here. Back in April Poly wrapped every balance on the platform from USDC into their own token, pUSD. It's backed 1:1 by USDC and shows up as a plain dollar balance, so most people never even noticed. Why bother then. There's a few hundred million locked in open bets over there at any given moment.
